optimization_rationale: More instances = better parallelization for hierarchical testing
4x c5.xlarge cheaper than 2x c5.4xlarge with better task distribution
Parallel execution reduces duration from 48h to 36h
Better matches hierarchical architecture we're testing

phase_1_launch.action: Launch 4x c5.xlarge instances with optimized configuration
phase_1_launch.aws_command:
aws ec2 run-instances \
    --image-id ami-0029f5c55e3fbb8d7 \
    --count 4 \
    --instance-type c5.xlarge \
    --security-group-ids sg-079f48abca9795b2c \
    --subnet-id subnet-0496763b3fb523c1b \
    --block-device-mappings '[{"DeviceName":"/dev/xvda","Ebs":{"VolumeSize":30,"VolumeType":"gp3"}}]' \
    --user-data file://unified_experiment_userdata.sh \
    --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=instance,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=unified_hierarchical_exp},{Key=Purpose,Value=delegation_fourth_dimension_ml}]'

phase_2_delegation_testing.instances: All 4 instances test different delegation strategies in parallel
testing_focus: Instance 3: Task-type specific delegation (optimal per task class)

phase_3_fourth_dimension_integration.instances: All instances collaborate on fourth-dimension logic testing

phase_4_ml_optimization.instances: GPU-optimized ML training on accumulated data
phase_4_ml_optimization.gpu_upgrade: Upgrade 1 instance to p3.large for ML acceleration
phase_4_ml_optimization.expected_outcome: Trained ML models for production use

phase_5_integration_validation.instances: All instances validate complete integrated system
phase_5_integration_validation.expected_outcome: Complete platform validation + functional system design

functional_system_prep.system_objective: Create working hierarchical task decomposition system useful for human coders

input_interface.description: Human coder describes a complex coding task in natural language
examples: Build a REST API with authentication and database integration
Create a React dashboard with real-time data updates
Implement a machine learning pipeline with A/B testing

task_decomposition.description: System breaks task into hierarchical components using experiment 1 results
task_decomposition.delegation_strategy: Use optimal strategy determined by experiment (likely task-type specific)
task_decomposition.component_generation: Automated component creation with estimated times

execution_orchestration.description: System coordinates component execution with human oversight
execution_modes: Fully automated: System executes all components
Guided mode: Human approves each component before execution
Review mode: System generates plan, human executes manually

learning_integration.description: System learns from successful task completions
learning_integration.ml_optimization: Uses ML models from experiment phase 4
learning_integration.component_reuse: Builds library of reusable logic blocks
learning_integration.continuous_improvement: Updates delegation strategies based on success rates

local_component.description: CLI tool running on developer's machine
responsibilities: Task input and natural language processing

success_criteria: Successfully decompose and execute 80% of common coding tasks
Reduce task completion time by 30% compared to manual approach
Generate reusable components that improve over time

post_experiment_development_plan.week_1: Build MVP CLI tool with basic task decomposition
post_experiment_development_plan.week_3: Add ML optimization and component reuse
post_experiment_development_plan.week_4: User testing and iteration based on feedback
